about: Pro races fred always shows in News › Racing (item 47). The World Triathlon API carries WTCS only, so IRONMAN, IRONMAN 70.3 and T100 races are typed here from the organisers' official announcements: name, series, date, place, time zone and official links (facts and links only; start times only when officially published, as ISO date-times with the local offset). Every news job merges the races of the weeks around today into data/news.json (confirmed: true). A link may list candidate URLs: the daily job checks them once a day (HTTP 200, not redirected to a home page or another site) and keeps the first that opens; until a check, the first is shown; when every candidate is broken, none is shown and the job reports it (like a broken standings link). Add a race: series (IRONMAN · 70.3 · T100 · WTCS), name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), place, tz, official_url, and start_lists when the organiser publishes them.
